qemu_runtime: QEMU 11.1.2 version identity; binary identity with retained upstream source is unknown
qemu_profile_coupling: QEMU requires VFP-D32 and Neon together. Disabled controls use cortex-a15,neon=off,vfp-d32=off; no independent hardware field-isolation claim.

first_oracle_attempt.result: 22 enabled controls passed; 22 disabled launches rejected configuration because Neon was off while D32 remained enabled; raw outputs preserved.

synthetic_field_controls: RAX independently varies absent and reserved fields. These are manual-derived admission controls, not identities of processors combining all selected fields.
